question: Among superheroes with missing weight data, find those whose eye and hair colors are the same, and who possess more than 10 superpowers. Return their names ordered by their speed attribute in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
WHERE T1."XCL_029" IS NULL
  AND T1."XCL_022" = T1."XCL_023"
  AND T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_012") > 10
ORDER BY T3."XCL_011" DESC
